concept: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보 데이터에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

prompt_en: A layered costume photograph shows a model guided by the attached portrait, portrayed as an adult fictional spacecraft technician. Her short dark bob, airy separated bangs, gently rounded face and large dark eyes follow the visual cues of the reference. She wears a plainly visible costume: a retro space workwear one-piece jumpsuit in matte ivory woven fabric, with a compact upright collar, a central front zipper, rust-orange shoulder and chest panels, two utility chest pockets, a narrow webbing waist belt with a small metal buckle, reinforced knee patches, pale work gloves and ankle-high utility boots. Her one-piece jumpsuit stays continuous across the waist into both trouser legs. The central front zipper follows the front of that same ivory coverall from its upright collar toward the waist. The narrow belt rests over the continuous cloth, with the coverall waist sides visible around it. At the end of a maintenance shift she stands beside a waist-high service-door lever in an old orbital workshop, turning the lever through a small quarter turn with her right gloved hand. Her right elbow is softly bent and the lever is beside her right hip, clear of her torso; her left arm hangs relaxed and both boots rest on the grated floor. The turned lever sits in a diagonal position against its circular mounting plate. Behind her, ribbed wall panels and a partly open service hatch recede toward a round frosted observation window. Amber light from a caged work lamp grazes the zipper teeth and glove creases, while cool blue window light rims her bob and separates the matte cloth from a brushed-metal door. A full-length three-quarter front view keeps her face, the whole garment and the hand-to-lever contact readable, with the calm end-of-shift expression and tactile uniform as the visual center.
